note: Baselines drawn from Brady, Konkle, Alvarez & Oliva (2008, PNAS) recognition memory paradigm. The published study used ~2,500 unique object photographs and reports d' ~2.5, hit rate ~0.92, false alarm ~0.08, overall accuracy ~0.87 for adult human participants. v1 port uses procedural SVG stimuli (768 unique combinations of shape × color × pattern × orientation), which are likely *easier* to discriminate than photographs because of their compositional structure; we may need to revise these baselines downward after on-platform calibration in v2.
